notes: A genuine fallback is counted only for a source navigation command after a related empty, capped, ambiguous, or error MCP result.
Exact-name misses with ranked results are not treated as empty responses; literal searches are allowed; ambiguous selection responses are expected selection results, not engine errors.
Fallback counts describe observed actions and do not establish a defect or policy violation.
Slot 10 item_28 is a transient watcher freshness refusal with unset JSON-RPC/error flags; check_edit item_30 succeeds next. It is not counted as a native shell fallback.
Unknown is retained for source reads with prior successful MCP evidence or mixed commands where fallback/direct-search status is not provable.
No source text, command strings, or model reasoning is copied into this report.
